message.content: {"note_claim": "The Queen visited Ethiopia in 1965 and no evidence shows she bowed to Haile Selassie; the photo shows unidentified guests, not the Queen and Prince Philip.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Since she ascended the throne in 1952 the Queen and Prince Philip have made one official trip to Ethiopia and it was not until 1965.", "reason": "The page states the Queen's only Ethiopia visit was in 1965, that the photo shows unnamed guests, and that the bow claim was discredited; it dates the photo to 1955 rather than 1958, a minor discrepancy."}

parsed.note_claim: The Queen visited Ethiopia in 1965 and no evidence shows she bowed to Haile Selassie; the photo shows unidentified guests, not the Queen and Prince Philip.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Since she ascended the throne in 1952 the Queen and Prince Philip have made one official trip to Ethiopia and it was not until 1965.
parsed.reason: The page states the Queen's only Ethiopia visit was in 1965, that the photo shows unnamed guests, and that the bow claim was discredited; it dates the photo to 1955 rather than 1958, a minor discrepancy.
